latHint: Think the goddess of love and beauty in ancient myth.
pivHint: The psalmist declares that the EARTH is the Lord's. In our solar system, the planet just closer to the sun than EARTH is ______.
winText: You found it. EARTH isn't just the Lord's creation in the psalm. It's the third planet from the sun, right after VENUS.
lossText: The word was VENUS. EARTH was the pivot. EARTH is the third planet from the sun, and the planet just before it, closer to the sun, is VENUS.
votdVerse: The earth is the Lord’s, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it;
passageText: The earth is the Lord’s, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it; for he founded it on the seas and established it on the waters. Who may ascend the mountain of the Lord? Who may stand in his holy place? The one who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not trust in an idol or swear by a false god.
